records.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='/tmp/opencut-legitate-oidc-review.yml'
s=open(p).read(); s=s.replace('          - http://localhost:3211/api/accounts/legitate/callback\n','          - http://localhost:3211/api/accounts/legitate/callback\n          - http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/accounts/legitate/callback\n          - http://127.0.0.1:3211/api/accounts/legitate/callback\n'); open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
img=$(docker inspect metrix-platform-authelia-1 --format '{{.Config.Image}}'); docker run --rm --volumes-from metrix-platform-authelia-1 -v /tmp/opencut-legitate-oidc-review.yml:/tmp/review.yml:ro -e X_AUTHELIA_CONFIG_FILTERS=template -e AUTHELIA_IDENTITY_VALIDATION_RESET_PASSWORD_JWT_SECRET_FILE=/run/secrets/authelia_jwt_secret -e AUTHELIA_SESSION_SECRET_FILE=/run/secrets/authelia_session_secret -e AUTHELIA_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE=/run/secrets/authelia_storage_encryption_key --entrypoint /app/authelia "$img" config validate --config /tmp/review.yml
